title: Oracle shadow action compatibility
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $S$ a state type, $i$ one of $n$ tape indices, $a$ an action on $n$ Boolean tapes, $c$ a configuration on Boolean input $x$, and $b$ a Boolean tag. Applying the augmented action to the augmented configuration equals the augmented configuration after applying $a$, with its tag changed to the indicator of a non-leftward move when the origin marker at the selected tape head is true, and otherwise left equal to $b$.
